verdict.rationale: Missive documents connecting Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, or IMAP accounts, with full two-way Gmail sync including labels, so existing mailboxes become available in the app. It also syncs contacts with Office 365 and Google address books. This is account sync rather than a documented migration or import, and the evidence never says how much past mail is brought in. missing for 10: confirmation that the complete mail history is synced, import from local clients or archive files (e.g. mbox/PST), contact import from other providers or files (e.g. vCard/CSV), hands-on corroboration of a migration.
